description: This file contains unit tests for the function buildNodeShellCommand, which builds platform-specific shell commands based on input commands and platform labels. It uses the Vitest testing framework and references the buildNodeShellCommand function from an external module.

methods.name: buildNodeShellCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to run shell commands on different platforms, choosing between 'cmd.exe' for Windows-based platforms and '/bin/sh' for Unix-like platforms as tested.
